what_is_it.heading: Izifo ezithathelana ngokocansi ngendlela esobala
what_is_it.lede: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi zisuka komunye umuntu ziye komunye ngesikhathi socansi - ngesitho sangasese sowesifazane, sangemuva noma ngomlomo. Zivame kakhulu, ngokuvamile azinazo izimpawu, futhi eziningi zelashwa kalula uma zibanjwe kusenesikhathi.
paragraphs: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezibangelwa amagciwane (i-chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea, i-syphilis, i-trichomoniasis) ziyelapheka ngokusebenzisa ama-antibiotics. Ama-STI wegciwane (i-herpes, i-HPV, i-HIV, i-hepatitis B) alawulwa isikhathi eside kodwa awelapheki ngokuphelele ngokwelashwa. Kunoma ikuphi, ukuhlola yikho okwenza ukwelashwa kwenzeke.

Iningi lama-STI alinazo izimpawu ezisobala — ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane. Uma engelashwa, angabangela ukungabi nenzalo, izinkinga zokukhulelwa, nokwandisa ingozi yokuthola noma ukudlulisa i-HIV. Azilona uphawu lokuziphatha okubi. Ziwuphawu lwempilo evamile yocansi kanye nokuhlolwa okufanele.

items.headline: Ngokuvamile kuthule
items.body: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi eziningi azibangeli nhlobo izimpawu - ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane. Ukuhlola ukuphela kwendlela ethembekile yokwazi.

items.headline: Ukuhlola kwamahhala
items.body: Yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni inikeza ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-STI mahhala, okuyimfihlo. Akukho ukuqokwa, akukho usizo lwezokwelapha.

items.headline: Eziningi ziyelapheka
items.body: I-Chlamydia, i-gonorrhoea, i-syphilis, ne-trichomoniasis konke kwelapheka ngenkambo emfushane yemithi elwa namagciwane noma umjovo owodwa.

items.headline: Phathani ndawonye
items.body: Uma une-STI, ozakwethu bakamuva nabo badinga ukwelashwa - ngisho noma bezizwa bephilile. Uma kungenjalo uzowudlulisela phambili naphambili.

pull_quote.text: Ukuhlolwa kwe-STI kungenye yezinto ezikhathalela kakhulu ongazenzela wena, umuntu olala naye, nanoma ibaphi ozakwethu bakusasa. Kumahhala futhi kuthatha imizuzu.

signs.heading: Ongase ukuqaphele - nalokho ongavamile ukukubona
signs.lede: Iningi lama-STI lithule. Uma kuvela izimpawu, ziyahlukahluka kuye ngokuthi unasiphi isifo. Izimpawu ezifanayo zingasho izinto ezihlukile - ukuhlolwa kuphela okungasho.

items.title: Ukukhipha okungajwayelekile
items.description: Kusuka emomozini, epipini, noma endunu. Kungaba namafu, kubephuzi, kuluhlaza, kunuke, noma kuhluke nje kokujwayelekile. Okujwayelekile ku-chlamydia, gonorrhoea, trichomoniasis.

items.title: Ubuhlungu noma ukushisa
items.description: Lapho uchama, ngesikhathi socansi, noma ngaphansi kwesisu. Kwesinye isikhathi kubhekwe ngephutha negciwane le-urinary tract.

items.title: Izilonda, amaqhubu, noma ama-rash
items.description: Ezithweni zangasese, ididi, emlonyeni, noma ezandleni. Kungaba buhlungu noma kungabi buhlungu. Okujwayelekile ku-herpes, ugcunsula, i-HPV.

items.title: Izimpawu ezingabonakali kancane
items.description: Ubuhlungu bomphimbo (igonorrhoea yomlomo), izindlala ezivuvukele, ukugula okufana nomkhuhlane (acute HIV), ukopha okungajwayelekile phakathi nokuya esikhathini (ukutheleleka komlomo wesibeletho).

spreads.heading: Indlela ama-STIs asakazeka ngayo - nokuthi awasakazeki kanjani
yes: Ucansi lwesitho sangasese sowesifazane, sangemuva, noma somlomo ngaphandle kwekhondomu
Ukwabelana ngamathoyizi ocansi ngaphandle kokuhlanza noma ukumboza
Ukuthintana kwezitho zangasese zesikhumba nesikhumba (i-HPV, i-herpes - ngisho nangekhondomu)
Umama emntwaneni ngesikhathi ekhulelwe, ezalwa, noma encelisa (ezinye izifo zocansi)
Ukuthintana kwegazi negazi (izinaliti zokwabelana, ukumpontshelwa okungahloliwe)
no: Ukugona, ukubambana ngezandla, noma ukuqabulana (eziningi zezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi)
Ukwabelana ngokudla, iziphuzo, amapuleti, noma okokudla
Izindlu zangasese, amadamu okubhukuda, okugeza, noma amashawa
Ukuxhumana okungajwayelekile emsebenzini, esikoleni, noma esidlangalaleni

items.myth: Uma bebukeka bephilile, abanaso isifo esithathelwana ngocansi.
items.fact: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi eziningi azibangeli zimpawu ezibonakalayo. Awukwazi ukusho ngokubheka umuntu - kuhlanganise nawe. Ukuhlola ukuphela kwendlela ethembekile.
Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi eziningi zisakazwa ngocansi lomlomo - i-gonorrhoea, i-chlamydia, i-syphilis, i-herpes, i-HPV. Amakhondomu namadamu amazinyo anciphisa ubungozi.

Amakhondomu asebenza kahle kakhulu ezifweni eziningi zocansi uma esetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi esikhumbeni sesikhumba njenge-HPV kanye ne-herpes zisengasakazeka ezindaweni ezingamboziwe.
Ungathola i-STI yebhaktheriya efanayo futhi ngemva kokwelashwa. Ukuphinda kuhlolwe izinyanga ezi-3 ngemuva kokwelashwa kunconywa i-chlamydia ne-gonorrhoea.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzivikela
prevention.lede: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi eziningi ziyagwemeka ngemikhuba embalwa elula. Akekho kubo odinga ukuyeka ucansi - nje ukuba nalo ngokuqaphela okwengeziwe.

items.title: Amakhondomu ngaso sonke isikhathi
items.description: Amakhondomu abesilisa noma abesifazane, asetshenziswe ngendlela efanele kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo, amakhemisi amaningi, ngisho nakumagalaji kaphethiloli.

items.title: Umgomo we-HPV
items.description: Kumahhala e-SA kumantombazane afunda iBanga lesi-5 futhi manje abafana ezifundazweni eziningi. Ivikela kumdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, izinsumpa zangasese neminye imidlavuza.

items.title: Hlola ngaphambi kozakwethu abasha
items.description: Hlolani ngaphambi kocansi nomlingani omusha, kahle ndawonye. Kumahhala, kuyashesha, kuyimfihlo. Imitholampilo eminingi inikeza imiphumela nge-HIV emizuzwini eyi-15.

items.title: I-PrEP ye-HIV
items.description: Iphilisi lansuku zonke elivimbela i-HIV. Kumahhala emitholampilo. Iwusizo kubantu abasengozini enkulu - abalingani abasha njalo, abalingani abane-HIV, abathengisa ngomzimba.

items.title: Hlola
items.description: Hamba kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni. Cela isikrini esigcwele se-STI - i-HIV, i-syphilis, i-gonorrhoea, i-chlamydia. Imiphumela eminingi phakathi nemizuzu kuya ezinsukwini.

items.title: Uma positive - qala ukwelashwa ngosuku olufanayo
items.description: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezibangelwa amagciwane ngokuvamile ziyelapheka ngenkambo emfushane yemithi elwa namagciwane noma umjovo owodwa. Thatha konke njengoba kushiwo.

items.title: Tshela ozakwethu bakamuva
items.description: Noma ubani oke waya naye ocansini ezinyangeni eziyisi-6 ezedlule udinga ukuhlolwa. Umtholampilo ungakusiza ubatshele ngokungaziwa uma kudingeka.

items.title: Alukho ucansi ngenkathi welashwa
items.description: Linda kuze kube yilapho umtholampilo uthi ucacile. Kungenjalo uzolidlulisela kumlingani osanda kwelapha.

items.title: Phinda uhlole ezinyangeni ezi-3
items.description: Izifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezibangelwa amagciwane zingabuya uma uzakwethu engazange alashwe. Ukuhlolwa kokulandelela kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutheleleka sekuhambile.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukuhlolwa kwe-STI kumahhala, kuyashesha, futhi kuyimfihlo kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni. Ayikho i-medical aid, akukho ukwahlulela, akukho mibuzo ongafuni ukuyiphendula.
